eyebrow: Safe to cache, and what isn't
code:
Safe: static knowledge, docs lookups,
      anything that doesn't change day to day

Dangerous without real invalidation:
      live data (balances, prices, inventory)
      personalized responses
      anything where stale is worse than slow
caption: A stale semantic-cache hit reads as fine -- fluent, on-topic, and wrong.
